Aura Space Infra Pvt. Ltd. – Comprehensive Inspection & Quality Assurance Services

In today’s highly competitive engineering and infrastructure environment, the role of inspection and quality assurance services has become more critical than ever. Companies must not only comply with international codes and standards but also ensure reliability, safety, and long-term performance of their assets.

Aura Space Infra Pvt. Ltd. has positioned itself as a trusted partner in this mission, offering a wide spectrum of inspection, testing, and quality control solutions tailored to the needs of industries such as Oil & Gas, Power, Petrochemicals, Refining, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing. Much like industry leaders such as TCR Advanced Engineering and Quest Global, Aura Space Infra delivers world-class services backed by technical expertise, certified professionals, and a customer-first approach.

🔎 Inspection & Testing Services Offered by Aura Space Infra Pvt. Ltd.

1. Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Services

  • Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
  • Radiographic Testing (RT) & Film Interpretation
  • Magnetic Particle Testing (MPT)
  • Dye Penetrant Testing (DPT)
  • Visual Testing (VT)
  • Eddy Current Testing (ECT)
  • Advanced NDT (Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing – PAUT, Time of Flight Diffraction – TOFD, Digital Radiography)

2. Metallurgical & Corrosion Investigation

  • Failure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation
  • Metallography (Field & Lab)
  • Positive Material Identification (PMI)
  • Corrosion Assessment & Monitoring
  • Coating & Lining Inspection

3. Welding & Fabrication Inspection

  • Welder and Procedure Qualification (WPS/PQR/WPQ)
  • Third-Party Welding Inspection
  • Welding Defect Assessment & Repair Approval
  • Heat Treatment (Pre/Post Weld) Supervision

4. In-Service Inspection & RBI

  • Fitness-for-Service (FFS) Assessments
  • Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) Studies
  • Pressure Vessel, Piping, and Tank Inspection
  • Integrity Management for Static Equipment
  • API 510/570/653 Certified Services

5. Calibration & Dimensional Inspection

  • Instrument Calibration (Pressure, Temperature, Flow, Electrical)
  • Dimensional & Geometrical Inspection for Components and Structures
  • GA/As-Built Drawing Verification

6. Civil & Infrastructure Quality Services

  • Concrete Testing & Reinforcement Inspection
  • Non-Destructive Civil Tests (Rebound Hammer, Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity)
  • Structural Integrity Assessment of Buildings, Bridges, and Infrastructure

7. Third-Party Inspection & Certification

  • Vendor Inspection & Expediting Services
  • Witnessing & Certification as per International Standards (ASME, ASTM, ISO, API, AWS)
  • Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) Documentation & Review

🌍 Why Choose Aura Space Infra Pvt. Ltd.?

✅ Technical Expertise: Team of experienced metallurgists, inspection engineers, welding inspectors, and NDT Level-II/III professionals.
✅ Industry Standards: Compliance with ASME, API, ISO, AWS, ASTM, BIS, and NABL/ILAC guidelines.
✅ Client-Centric Approach: Customized inspection programs aligned with project timelines and regulatory requirements.
✅ Integrated Solutions: Combining engineering expertise with AI-driven inspection methodologies for next-generation quality assurance.
✅ Pan-India Reach: Serving refineries, petrochemical complexes, EPC projects, fabrication shops, and industrial plants across India.

🚀 Delivering Trust, Reliability & Excellence

At Aura Space Infra Pvt. Ltd., inspection is not just about detecting defects—it’s about ensuring safety, performance, and reliability throughout the lifecycle of assets. From design verification to fabrication, from commissioning to in-service inspection, Aura Space Infra provides an end-to-end assurance framework for industries that cannot afford to compromise on quality.

INDUSTRIES WE SERVE
Pharmaceutical Industries
Aura plays a vital role in empowering the pharmaceutical industry with high-quality chemical solutions. We provide a diverse range of raw materials, intermediates, and specialty chemicals essential for drug manufacturing and formulation.
Our products adhere to stringent quality and safety standards, ensuring compliance with global pharmaceutical regulations. Our offerings enhance efficiency, reliability, and innovation in pharmaceutical manufacturing.
With a commitment to excellence and sustainability, Aura Chemicals supports the pharmaceutical industry in delivering safe and effective medicines to improve lives worldwide.
Healthcare and Diagnostics Industry
Aura plays a pivotal role in advancing the health and diagnostics industry by supplying high-purity chemicals and reagents essential for accurate and reliable diagnostics.
Our product portfolio includes biochemicals, diagnostic reagents, stabilizers, and specialty solvents tailored for use in medical diagnostics, laboratory testing, and healthcare applications. These solutions meet stringent quality standards, ensuring precision and consistency in diagnostic results.
With our expertise and commitment to excellence, Aura Chemicals supports the health and diagnostics industry in delivering innovative solutions that improve patient care and contribute to better healthcare outcomes.
Cosmetics and Personal Care Industry
Aura  is a trusted partner for the cosmetic and personal care industry, offering a wide range of premium-grade ingredients tailored to enhance product performance and consumer satisfaction.
Our portfolio includes emollients, surfactants, active ingredients, stabilizers, and preservatives designed for applications in skincare, haircare, and beauty formulations. We prioritize quality, safety, and sustainability, ensuring our products meet stringent regulatory standards while enabling innovative product development.
By providing high-quality raw materials and expert guidance, Aura Chemicals empowers the cosmetic and personal care industry to create effective, safe, and environmentally responsible products that resonate with modern consumers.
Food and Beverage Industry
Aura is a trusted supplier to the food and beverage industry, providing high-quality ingredients and additives that ensure safety, consistency, and enhanced product appeal.
Our range includes preservatives, emulsifiers, flavor enhancers, stabilizers, and food-grade processing aids that comply with global safety standards. These solutions help manufacturers improve shelf life, maintain product integrity, and meet consumer expectations for quality and taste.
With a focus on innovation and sustainability, Aura Chemicals empowers the food and beverage industry to deliver safe, nutritious, and high-quality products that cater to the evolving needs of modern consumers.
Water Treatment Industry
Aura  is a trusted partner for the water treatment industry, offering a wide range of premium chemicals designed to optimize water quality and treatment processes.
Our products include coagulants, flocculants, pH adjusters, and anti-scalants, tailored to meet the specific requirements of water purification, wastewater management, and industrial water treatment. With a focus on efficiency and sustainability, our solutions help industries achieve cleaner water, comply with environmental regulations, and reduce operational costs.
By combining innovative products with expert technical support, Aura Chemicals ensures the water treatment industry has the tools needed to address today’s water challenges effectively and
Electronics and Semiconductor Industry
Aura is a key partner for the electronics and semiconductor industry, delivering high-purity chemicals essential for precision manufacturing and advanced technology development.
Our portfolio includes etchants, solvents, cleaning agents, and deposition materials tailored to meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor fabrication, PCB manufacturing, and electronic assembly. We ensure consistent quality and compliance with global standards, enabling superior performance and reliability in electronic components.
By providing innovative chemical solutions and expert technical support, Aura Chemicals empowers the electronics and semiconductor industry to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and meet the demands of a rapidly evolving market.
Adhesives and Sealants Industry
Aura provides the adhesives and sealants industry with a comprehensive range of high-performance chemical solutions essential for product innovation and reliability.
Our offerings include resins, curing agents, stabilizers, and specialty additives that enhance adhesion, durability, and flexibility across a wide array of applications. Whether for industrial bonding, construction, packaging, or automotive needs, our chemicals are formulated to meet stringent quality and performance standards.
With a commitment to sustainability and technical excellence, Aura Chemicals empowers the adhesives and sealants industry to create stronger, more efficient, and eco-friendly solutions for a diverse market.
Leather and Tanning Industry
At Aura we pride ourselves on being a reliable partner to the textile industry. Our comprehensive range of high-quality chemicals is tailored to meet the diverse needs of textile manufacturing processes, from dyeing and printing to finishing.
We provide eco-friendly and performance-enhancing solutions that ensure vibrant colors, durable fabrics, and efficient production. Our products are rigorously tested for quality and comply with global standards, helping textile manufacturers achieve superior results while maintaining sustainability.
By delivering innovative chemical solutions and unparalleled customer support, Aura Chemicals empowers the textile industry to stay competitive and environmentally responsible.
Plastics and Polymers Industry
